name: Swathi
headline: I turn designs into Shopify stores and static websites.
intro: You bring the design. I build it into a working site that looks the way it was drawn, and works just as well on a phone as on a laptop.

seo.title: Swathi · Web designer
seo.description: Swathi builds Shopify stores, WordPress pages and static websites from finished designs, made to work on phones first.

services.name: Shopify stores
services.summary: For brands that sell online. Your design becomes a Shopify store you can run yourself: add products, change banners, take orders.
items: Theme built to match your design
Menu, search and cart that work on phones
A walkthrough so you can add products yourself

services.name: Static websites
services.summary: For businesses that need a few clear pages, not a shop. Quick to load, cheap to host and nothing to update every month.
items: WhatsApp, call and map buttons where people look for them
Light pages that open fast on mobile data
Set up on your own domain

services.name: WordPress pages
services.summary: Landing pages and full sites in WordPress with Elementor, for teams that want to change their own text and photos.
items: Landing pages for ads and offers
Sections you can edit without code

process.name: Design file
process.text: You send the design: a Figma file, a Canva page or screenshots. We agree on the pages and what each one needs to do.

process.name: Build
process.text: I build it page by page and share a preview link, so you can see it take shape and ask for changes early.

process.name: Phone check
process.text: Every page is checked on phones and laptops: readable text, buttons big enough to tap, nothing that slides sideways.

process.name: Launch
process.text: The site goes live on your domain, and you get a short walkthrough of how to update it.

about.heading: Hi, I'm Swathi.
paragraphs: I'm a web designer. Most projects reach me as a finished design, and my job is to build it into a site that works: a Shopify store for brands that sell online, or a WordPress or static site for everyone else.

So far that has meant stores for a jewellery brand and two clothing labels, a landing page for a skin and hair clinic in Coimbatore, and a site for an ocean adventure company. Most people open sites like these on a phone, so that's where every page starts.

contact.heading: Have a design that needs building?
contact.text: Send it over on Instagram with a line about what you need, and I'll get back to you with how I'd build it.
contact.whatsappMessage: Hi Swathi, I saw your portfolio and have a design I'd like built.
